Given these are all low-volume, single-day counts, none of this should be read as a slowdown in model-serving or training-framework development — it's the kind of swing that's routine for weekend commit cadence on any given repo.

NVDA and SMCI are the exceptions, both flat-to-slightly-up on 30-day postings. The CRWV and EQIX overall-jobs figures (-94.2% and -97.4%) are likely artifacts of source/listing resets (Greenhouse and Workday feeds respectively) rather than real signal, so I wouldn't read into those.
